title: The Constant
goal: Make LIMIT a proper compile-time constant that the comparison accepts.
hints: `let` only works inside functions. What lives at the top level?
`used` is an i32. The comparison needs both sides to agree.
explanation: Top-level values use `const`, and `const` always requires a type annotation. The type must also agree with its users: `used` is an `i32`, so comparing it against a `u8` or `f64` LIMIT is E0308. `static mut` compiles nothing here - reading it would even require unsafe. `const LIMIT: i32` is the whole story.
